experiment_name: canonical 1D ResNet with A1 scale-0.5 input augmentation and latent feature generation

validation.epoch_selection: median of the five fold best epochs (round half up)
validation.target_use: load and evaluate Batches 2-10 exactly once only after source-only selection and final-model freezing

architecture.name: canonical 1D ResNet B0 backbone with A2 insertion after block 3

training.loss: equal-weight mean of original and generated CrossEntropyLoss

augmentation.schedule: fixed once per training fold and once for final source fit
augmentation.partner_sampling: uniform among same-class non-self source-training samples; replacement across anchors allowed
augmentation.label: preserve anchor gas label

latent_feature_generation.sampling_rule: from the active source-training mini-batch, detach per-sample per-channel mu_L and log(sigma_L); fit independent population Gaussians across samples for each channel; independently sample one mu and log-sigma per sample/channel; exponentiate sampled log-sigma
latent_feature_generation.schedule: one stochastic generated branch view for every training input on every optimization encounter

implementation_assumptions.standard_scaler: Fit on original samples in the active Batch 1 training fold; final scaler fit on all original Batch 1.
implementation_assumptions.a1_training_inputs: The fixed A1 view is retained alongside each original, so each fold has twice its original source-training sample count.
implementation_assumptions.latent_sampling: Mini-batch Gaussian estimation, population standard deviations, channel independence, latent RNG seed, and one generated view on every optimization encounter are project assumptions where the main paper is unspecified.
implementation_assumptions.shared_tail_execution: Original and generated latents are concatenated and passed together through the exact same block-4, block-5, FC128, BatchNorm, and FC6 objects.
implementation_assumptions.final_epoch_rule: Round-half-up median of the five source-fold selected epochs.
implementation_assumptions.interpretation: Low-frequency statistics as domain/drift style and high-frequency structure as gas identity is an unproven project assumption; generation is not claimed to physically reproduce sensor drift.
